name: self-healing-evaluation
description: JEV criteria for evaluating optimal self-healing actions based on system health metrics and historical recovery outcomes

options.description: Restart the affected service to clear transient state and resource leaks
Add more instances to handle increased load or recover from instance failures
Roll back to previous stable version if recent deployment caused issues
Allocate more CPU/memory/disk resources to the affected service
Clear service cache to resolve stale data or memory issues

evaluation_factors: Current system health metrics (error rate, response time, resource utilization)
Historical success rates for each corrective action in similar situations
Risk and impact of each action on service availability
Time required for recovery with each approach
Recurrence patterns after different healing actions
